276930755.description:
Green Aventurine & Citrine Gemstone Lot
56.1 grams
Natural Mineral Specimens
This listing features two distinct natural mineral specimens: a polished green aventurine tumbled stone and a rough citrine crystal. Aventurine is known for its shimmering "aventurescence" caused by platy mineral inclusions, while this citrine specimen exhibits the classic pale yellow hue and crystalline structure typical of quartz varieties.
One polished tumbled green aventurine stone with dark green inclusions
One rough citrine crystal point with internal fracturing and natural surfaces
Combined total weight of 56.1 grams
Sizes shown relative to a standard US penny (approx. 0.75" diameter)
Condition:
Good condition specimens. The aventurine stone is polished to a high luster with some minor surface pitting consistent with natural tumbled stones. The citrine is in its rough, unpolished state with sharp edges and natural crystalline growth patterns. No major damage or repairs observed.
